Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
text: Find resources using Eratos workspace API various search filter options.

title: Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
code: get_resources(   query = NULL,   limit = 20,   skip = 0,   exclude = NULL,   type = NULL,   excludeType = NULL,   owner = NULL,   collections = NULL,   facets = NULL,   sort = "@date:asc",   scope = NULL,   property_filters = NULL )

title: Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
text: query Character string. Free text search query - supports wildcards (*) simple /logic. limit Integer (1-100). Limit number results. Defaults 20. skip Integer (>= 0). Starting index results. Defaults 0. exclude Character string. Comma separated list ERNs IDs exclude. type Character string. Comma separated list ERNs IDs schema types include. excludeType Character string. Comma separated list ERNs IDs schema types exclude. owner Character string. Comma separated list owner ERNs. collections Character string. Comma separated list collection ERNs. facets Character string. Comma separated list facets. sort Character string. Sort order. Defaults "@date:asc". sorting name @date, type must specified. scope Character string. Scope query (e.g. "Public" "Private"). property_filters Named list. Advanced property filtering form list(property_name = list(op = "eq", value = "search_value")). Supported operations: "eq" (equal), "ne" (equal), "gt" (greater ), "lt" (less ), "ge" (greater equal), "le" (less equal). Note: Property functions require type also set.

title: Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
text: list containing API response resource data.

title: Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
text: function queries Eratos workspace API find resources matching specified criteria. API supports simple text search advanced property-based filtering. advanced querying using property_filters, properties exist schema type definition can queried, properties within schema queryable.

title: Get Resources from Eratos — get_resources
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Simple text search resources <- get_resources(query = "temperature*")  # Limit results and skip first 10 resources <- get_resources(query = "sensor", limit = 50, skip = 10)  # Filter by type and owner resources <- get_resources(   type = "ern:e-pn.io:resource:eratos.sensor",    owner = "ern:e-pn.io:resource:eratos.user.john" )  # Advanced property filtering resources <- get_resources(   type = "block",   property_filters = list(     creator = list(op = "eq", value = "ern:e-pn.io:resource:eratos.creator.eratos")   ) )  # Sort by date descending resources <- get_resources(sort = "@date:desc") } # }
